passages.text:
Hi Mike,
Thanks again for taking the time to meet with me and my colleagues at USAID last month. I'm attaching, for your
consideration, a draft document that provides an exploratory look at what a more formal partnership between USAID and
Facebook might look like on content policy issue in contexts where USAID is working.It is a product of our team's
thinking following our meeting that seeks to align existing Facebook and USAID initiatives so that we may increase our
impact in creating resilient information ecosystems in the countries where we work.
Please let us know your thoughts about the feasibility and appropriateness of such a partnership and the suggested terms
from Facebook's side.
Many thanks in advance. I look forward to your response.
Best,
Josh
Josh Machleder (he / him/his)
Senior Media and Internet Freedom Advisor
USAID Center of Excellence on Democracy, Human Rights and Governance
